issues.title: default/social-importer: CrashLoopBackOff
issues.cause: back-off 5m0s restarting failed container. Last exit: Error (code 1). 14 restarts.

issues.title: Argo CD app social-importer-chart Degraded
issues.cause: Deployment social-importer: Deployment "social-importer" exceeded its progress deadline

issues.title: BlackboxProbeFailed (https://community.shop.example)
issues.cause: community.shop.example has not answered for 12 minutes.

issues.title: Node rke2-node-5: memory 93% used
issues.cause: 13.9 GiB of 15.0 GiB. Beyond this the kubelet starts evicting pods.

issues.title: Node rke2-node-5: disk 88% full
issues.cause: From 85% the kubelet removes images, from 90% it sets DiskPressure and evicts pods.

issues.title: Kubernetes 1.33 no longer gets updates
issues.cause: The Kubernetes project stopped maintaining 1.33 on 2026-06-28, so security holes stay open. Upgrade to 1.35 or newer, one minor version at a time. Guide: https://docs.rke2.io/upgrades/manual_upgrade

issues.title: discourse/discourse: Pending
issues.cause: Not started for 40 min. 0/3 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient memory.

issues.title: CronJob default/appstore-metrics-reviews: last run failed
issues.cause: Job has reached the specified backoff limit

issues.title: PDB pgadmin/pgadmin blocks node drains
issues.cause: minAvailable: 1 with 1 pod: no disruption allowed, so a drain (kured, upgrade) waits forever. Add replicas or set maxUnavailable: 1.

issues.title: default/shop-web-app-chart is at its maximum (2 replicas)
issues.cause: The autoscaler wants 4 replicas but may not add them. Either the load is too high or maxReplicas is too low.

issues.title: PVC discourse/uploads pending for 25 min
issues.cause: No volume has been provisioned. StorageClass: longhorn. With WaitForFirstConsumer it waits until a pod uses it.

issues.title: CloudNativePG 1.26.1: 1 known vulnerability
issues.cause: GHSA-423p-g724-fr39 (critical, CVSS 9.9). Fixed in 1.28.3.

issues.title: Volume weblate/data-weblate-0 degraded
issues.cause: Fewer healthy replicas than the 3 requested. Longhorn rebuilds them as long as a node has room.

issues.title: Backup of volume pvc-48f693fa-69889 failed
issues.cause: failed to upload block: context deadline exceeded (S3 eu-central-2)

issues.title: Ceph rook-ceph: HEALTH_WARN
issues.cause: Ceph reports: RECENT_CRASH: 1 daemons have recently crashed. Details: ceph health detail in the toolbox.

issues.title: Last backup of default/shop-api-pg was 31 h ago
issues.cause: Expected at least every 26 h. Is the ScheduledBackup still running?

issues.title: Postgres discourse/discourse-pg: 1/2 instances ready
issues.cause: Waiting for the instances to become active

issues.title: Certificate translate.shop.example expires in 9 days
issues.cause: Automatic renewal should have kicked in long ago (planned: 2026-11-04). Check the cert-manager logs and the challenges.

issues.title: social-importer (default): 1 known vulnerability
issues.cause: CVE-2024-21538 (high, CVSS 7.5). Fixed in newer package versions: cross-spawn 7.0.5. Rebuild the image or use a newer one. Scanned by Trivy Operator 5 h ago: acme/social-importer:2026-11-20-3.

issues.title: Scrape target blackbox down (1)
issues.cause: Prometheus cannot reach https://community.shop.example. Their metrics and alerts are missing.

issues.title: KubePersistentVolumeFillingUp (monitoring)
issues.cause: The Prometheus volume will be full in about 4 days.

issues.title: Gatus group shop: 1 endpoint down
issues.cause: Gatus says the latest check failed: community. Not met: [STATUS] == 200

issues.title: discourse-discourse-community-shop-example@kubernetes: 12 % server errors
issues.cause: 212 of 1840 requests in the last 15 minutes ended in a 5xx. Usually the backend behind it is not ready or crashing.

issues.title: kured lock held for 3 h
issues.cause: rke2-node-5 holds the reboot lock. Until it lets go, no other node reboots and security updates wait.

issues.title: Velero backup daily-apps: PartiallyFailed
issues.cause: 2 errors, 1 warning. velero backup logs daily-apps-3

issues.title: pgadmin: 1 workload may run as root
issues.cause: Neither runAsNonRoot nor a runAsUser above 0 is set, so the image decides, and many images run as root. Affected: pgadmin. Set securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true, plus runAsUser if the image has no user of its own.

issues.title: pgadmin: 1 workload without a memory limit
issues.cause: Without a memory limit a container can use up the node's memory, and then the kernel kills some pod. Affected: pgadmin. Set resources.limits.memory, for example to twice the usual usage.

issues.title: CloudNativePG 1.26.1: newer version available
issues.cause: Patch: 1.26.2. Minor: 1.28.3. Read the release notes before updating.

issues.title: Traefik 3.3.6: newer version available
issues.cause: Patch: 3.3.7. Minor: 3.5.3. Read the release notes before updating.

issues.title: Argo CD app weblate-chart: change waiting for sync
issues.cause: Manual sync: the repository holds a change that has not been rolled out yet. Not an error, just so you know.

issues.title: shop-api-valkey (default): 1 known vulnerability
issues.cause: CVE-2023-42363 (medium, CVSS 5.5). No update that fixes them is known yet. Scanned by Trivy Operator 7 h ago: valkey/valkey:8.1-alpine.

issues.title: Policy require-run-as-nonroot: 1 violation
issues.cause: 1 resource violates it. validation error: Running as root is not allowed. Set runAsNonRoot to true. rule run-as-non-root failed at path /spec/securityContext/runAsNonRoot/

actions.label: Restart workloads
actions.description: Restart the Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet behind a problem.
actions.effect: May set the restartedAt annotation on the affected workload, like kubectl rollout restart.

actions.label: Argo CD: sync
actions.description: Sync an app that is out of sync.
actions.effect: May start a sync of the affected Argo CD app (a patch of its operation field).

actions.label: Argo CD: hard refresh
actions.description: Re-read an app's state from Git.
actions.effect: May set the annotation argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard on the affected app.

actions.label: Argo CD: roll back
actions.description: Take a manual-sync app back to a state it was deployed in before, also without a problem.
actions.effect: May start a sync of a manual-sync app to a revision from its own history (same source, a patch of its operation field). Only with actions.enabled in the Helm chart.

actions.label: CloudNativePG: backup
actions.description: Start an overdue backup right away.
actions.effect: May create one Backup object for the affected database cluster.

actions.label: Read logs
actions.description: Show the last lines of a crashed pod.
actions.effect: Only reads the last 300 lines of the pod an issue names; changes nothing.
